data.title: Poll shows Likud party, Benjamin Netanyahu, losing support amid Iran war, Torah study law | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: This is Likud’s lowest figure since August 2025, when it received 21 seats in a Maariv poll. However, the coalition bloc maintained its strength from last week at 50 seats.
